payload.title: The scaffold writes editable newsroom defaults as data
payload.description:
Agent instructions, procedures, starter policies and example sections should start as defaults and then belong to the site.

```gherkin
Feature: Newsroom scaffold

  Scenario: A new newsroom starts with defaults
    Given a new site with no newsroom records
    When I run the newsroom scaffold
    Then the site has agent instructions, a Story procedure, image rules and starter policies as records
    And an administrator can edit or replace each one

  Scenario: A profile changes the defaults
    Given the satire profile
    When I run the newsroom scaffold with that profile
    Then the records hold satire defaults instead of news defaults
```
